sql: INSERT INTO devices (device_id,module,building,zone,last_seen,reported_online,extras,source) VALUES ($id,$module,$building,$zone,$rx,$online,$extras,$source) ON CONFLICT(device_id) DO UPDATE SET last_seen=$rx, reported_online=$online, extras=CASE WHEN $is_status=1 THEN $extras ELSE extras END, source=$source;

sql: INSERT INTO alerts (ts,rx,device,module,building,zone,alert_type,severity,value,unit,source) SELECT $ts,$rx,$device,$module,$building,$zone,$type,$severity,$value,$unit,$source WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alerts WHERE device=$device AND alert_type=$type AND cleared_ts IS NULL);

const REG = {"CLASS-A-ESP32-01": ["classroom", "BLOCK-A", "ROOM-204"], "PARK-C-SIM-01": ["parking", "BLOCK-C", "LOT-1"], "PARK-C-SIM-02": ["parking", "BLOCK-C", "LOT-1"], "PARK-C-SIM-03": ["parking", "BLOCK-C", "LOT-1"], "PARK-C-SIM-04": ["parking", "BLOCK-C", "LOT-1"], "ENERGY-A-SIM-01": ["energy", "BLOCK-A", "LAB-101"], "WATER-B-SIM-01": ["water", "BLOCK-B", "TANK-1"], "WASTE-B-SIM-01": ["waste", "BLOCK-B", "BIN-01"], "SAFE-B-SIM-01": ["safety", "BLOCK-B", "LAB-2"]};
return [Object.keys(REG).map(id => ({params: {$id: id, $module: REG[id][0], $building: REG[id][1], $zone: REG[id][2]}}))];

sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO devices (device_id,module,building,zone,last_seen,reported_online,extras,source) VALUES ($id,$module,$building,$zone,NULL,0,'{}','registry');

cutoff = now - offline_s

sql: INSERT INTO alerts (ts,rx,device,module,building,zone,alert_type,severity,value,unit,source) SELECT $now,$now,d.device_id,d.module,d.building,d.zone,'device_offline','warning',0,'bool','backend' FROM devices d WHERE d.last_seen IS NOT NULL AND (d.reported_online=0 OR d.last_seen < $cutoff) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alerts a WHERE a.device=d.device_id AND a.alert_type='device_offline' AND a.cleared_ts IS NULL);
name: raise device_offline

sql: UPDATE alerts SET cleared_ts=$now WHERE alert_type='device_offline' AND cleared_ts IS NULL AND device IN (SELECT device_id FROM devices WHERE reported_online=1 AND last_seen >= $cutoff);
name: clear when back
